issues.description: Stray `dnf search python3.12` in CI install steps is noise, not work
issues.detail: The Amazon Linux and Rocky prepare steps now run `dnf update -y && dnf search python3.12 && dnf install git python3.12 -y`. `dnf search` produces output for humans; in a script it does nothing useful and just clutters CI logs. A small composable install step should be: update, install. Drop the search line.

issues.description: Three ruff rules disabled wholesale with a 'TODO: remove' comment
issues.detail: UP045, UP007, UP035 are the modern-typing rules that motivated this whole PR (Union/Optional -> `A | B`/`A | None`). Turning them off globally with a TODO is the opposite of the stated intent and the cleverness/discipline this change is supposed to lock in. Either land the mechanical rewrite now (it's a `ruff --fix` away for most of these) or open a tracked ticket referenced from the comment, not a bare TODO. Otherwise this becomes permanent.

issues.description: Dead 3.9-compat scaffolding left behind in wallet_request_types.py
issues.detail: `kw_only_dataclass` was removed cleanly, good. But `default_raise()` still carries the comment 'This should be impossible to hit and is just for < 3.10 compatibility' and is still used as `field(default_factory=default_raise)` throughout. With kw_only=True the default_factory dance is no longer needed for ordering — fields can simply be required. This is exactly the 'data structure becomes obvious' case: drop default_raise, make required fields required. Worth a follow-up sweep.

issues.description: cmd_classes.py `option()` default still routes through kwargs.get instead of using MISSING directly
issues.detail: With 3.9 gone, `default=kwargs.get("default", MISSING)` is fine but the comment block above it about '< 3.10 don't know about kw_only' was removed without simplifying the surrounding logic. Small win: the function now does one thing, which is what we want — just confirm the call sites that used to rely on the `None` default still behave correctly under MISSING. Worth one grep, not a blocker.

issues.description: Good swap to itertools.pairwise — note it for the rest of the codebase
issues.detail: `zip(ordered, ordered[1:])` -> `itertools.pairwise(ordered)` is exactly the right move: smaller, clearer, uses the stdlib filter. There are almost certainly more `zip(xs, xs[1:])` patterns in the repo now that 3.10 is the floor. A follow-up grep would pay for itself. Not blocking this PR.

review.summary: SMALL-AND-COMPOSABLE for the most part — dropping 3.9 lets the data structures get simpler (kw_only dataclasses become the default, version-gated branches disappear, default_default scaffolding melts away). That's the right direction. Two real concerns: the ruff config disables UP007/UP035/UP045 with a bare TODO, which silently retains the very `Union`/`Optional` patterns this PR is supposed to retire — file a ticket or do the mechanical rewrite now. And the CI install steps gained a `dnf search python3.12` line that's pure log noise. Smaller follow-ups: `default_raise` and its companion comments can probably go now that kw_only is universal, and the `zip(xs, xs[1:])` -> `itertools.pairwise` swap is worth applying repo-wide.
